component.name: Bragd
component.summary: Play, study and keep board games

description.p: Bragd is a desktop app for playing, studying and keeping board games: chess and its old and fairy Variants, xiangqi and janggi, shogi, go, draughts, tafl, backgammon, ur and senet.

ul.li: Play against yourself, a friend or an engine, with the rules of each game checked as you move
Keep your games in Libraries, and open other programs' databases where they are
Analyse with the engines you have, or sealed engine images
Themes and board themes, with Racing green by default

description.p: Nothing leaves the machine unless you ask: the update check can be turned off, and every download is your choice in Settings.
